contracts: Alignment retires a profile copy of a product bundle whenever its version differs from the bundled copy; a recorded earlier failure never suppresses the retry, so a profile a previous launch could not repair heals on the next launch.

An equal version performs no work, a profile copy without a readable manifest is quarantined, and a profile copy newer than the shipped one is replaced with the shipped copy and reported as a downgrade with the newer copy backed up.
The sealed runtime copy is located under Windows path rules (drive-letter case and separator differences) and through the explicit runtime node_modules chain before a profile copy is retired.

Every launch writes a bounded startup record (bundled version, profile copies, action, loaded version, platform, timestamp) and one post-load window sample (URL, html/body computed app region, drag-strip presence, legacy marker count); no record contains a credential and an unwritable log directory never blocks startup.

upstreamStatus.evidence: Local rc1 reconciliation: the alignment, log and window-diagnostic suites pass on the maintained rc1 source (24 focused cases); no upstream submission or remote CI receipt.
